FIRST review: opus holistic review posts the overview (diff-first), two web-backed research agents (ai-slop + general) + memories/docs + static tools gather context, a difficulty-scaled squad reviews, JS dedup + one check agent filters false positives, deterministic verdict, post, memory. RE-RUN: a hard 'first finish prev review' gate (ping overrides), comment management with resolve-with-message, then a significant-change check (JS prefilter + agent) decides whether to redraw the overview in place and re-research; the squad re-reviews either way. A small review-state marker (head sha + file count) records what was last reviewed for that check. Posting gated on post===true.

summary: cc-review brain (target spec): deterministic, zero-tolerance PR/MR review as one self-contained workflow. First-vs-re-run is decided by the bot's overview-comment marker. FIRST review: opus holistic review posts the overview (diff-first), two web-backed research agents (ai-slop + general) + memories/docs + static tools gather context, a difficulty-scaled squad reviews, JS dedup + one check agent filters false positives, deterministic verdict, post, memory. RE-RUN: a hard 'first finish prev review' gate (ping overrides), comment management with resolve-with-message, then a significant-change check (JS prefilter + agent) decides whether to redraw the overview in place and re-research; the squad re-reviews either way. A small review-state marker (head sha + file count) records what was last reviewed for that check. Posting gated on post===true.

{"ok":true,"platform":"github","repo":"Questi0nM4rk/ai-guardrails","prNumber":221,"localDryRun":false,"mode":"first","reviewed":true,"difficulty":3,"event":"REQUEST_CHANGES","totals":{"confirmed":4,"falsePositive":0,"resolved":0,"replied":0,"threadsOpen":0,"event":"REQUEST_CHANGES","difficulty":3,"reviewed":true,"rerun":false},"threadActions":[],"overview":"## cc-review CI rework — runtime-cloned pipeline + branch cleanup (Difficulty: 3/5)

This PR rewrites the three cc-review GitHub Actions workflows so the heavy review logic no longer lives inline in each consumer's YAML. Instead, both the auto-review and the `@cc-review` interactive workflows clone the cc-review bot at runtime (`git clone -b $CC_BOT_REF`) and delegate to its self-contained `scripts/ci-run.sh`, which means the review pipeline can be updated upstream once and every consumer picks it up on its next run. Alongside this, auth migrates from app-id to GitHub-App client-id, action pins bump (`checkout@v6`, `create-github-app-token@v3`), a config-driven `trigger:` gate (`pr_open` / `every_push` / `disabled`) replaces the old `auto_review:`/`mode:` parsing, and a new cleanup workflow deletes the ephemeral `pr-<N>-cc-review-output` log branch on PR close. The interactive workflow now writes the untrusted `@cc-review` message to `/tmp/cc-user-msg.txt` (read as data, never interpolated into the prompt) and gates on `issue.pull_request != null` so it only fires on PR comments.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["PR opened / reopened / synchronize / labeled"] --> G{"no-review label or bot author?"}
    G -->|"yes"| X["skip job"]
    G -->|"no"| T["read trigger: from .cc-review.yaml"]
    T --> D{"should_run? (event vs trigger)"}
    D -->|"false"| X
    D -->|"true"| C["clone cc-review bot @ CC_BOT_REF"]
    C --> R["run scripts/ci-run.sh (PING_OVERRIDE=false)"]

    P["@cc-review comment"] --> PG{"comment on a PR?"}
    PG -->|"no"| X
    PG -->|"yes"| M["write untrusted msg to /tmp/cc-user-msg.txt"]
    M --> R2["run ci-run.sh (PING_OVERRIDE=true)"]

    CL["PR closed"] --> DEL["delete pr-N-cc-review-output branch"]

    class A,G,T,D,C,R,P,PG,M,R2,CL,DEL chg
    classDef chg fill:#d6ffd9,stroke:#1a7f37,color:#111
```
